item.title: 2015 'X Factor Lithuania' Contestant Butchers Bieber's 'Sorry,' Becomes A Meme 10 Years Later
item.description: Jonatanas Kazlauskas' "Sorry" by Justin Bieber Performance is a viral video of singer Jonatanas Kazlauskas performing the song "Sorry" by Justin Bieber on X Factor Lithuania in 2015, in which he forgets the lyrics and awkwardly dances. The video was uploaded to YouTube in 2016 and resurfaced on Instagram Reels and TikTok in February 2026, inspiring memes and edits that both make fun of Kazlauskas' performance and show other performances of his to showcase his "redemption."

item.title: Image Of Two Chibi Characters Looking Into A Phone Camera Sparks Redraw Trend On Twitter
item.description: Chibi Characters Looking at Front Camera refers to a photo of two chibi versions of Haikyuu!! character figures looking at the front of a smartphone camera, resulting in their faces shown in it. The image became the subject of redraws and memes in early 2026, with numerous artists using it as a reference to draw other characters standing on the phone and looking into the camera.

item.title: AI Influencer 'Nia Noir' Hits 3 Million Followers In A Month For Allegedly Stealing Videos From Another Creator
item.description: Nia Noir or NiaNoir.xo, also known as NiaBasic is an AI influencer and model generated as an exceptionally dark skinned girl who contrasts her dark skin with colorful outfits. The Nia Noir TikTok and Instagram accounts were launched in late December 2025, the former gaining over 3 million followers in just over a month. She garnered criticism as she went viral for being AI-generated and purportedly stealing content from TikToker @tatianakaer, essentially reskinning her dance videos with Nia.

item.title: The 'Before vs. After Secret Wars' Meme Inspires Parodies On TikTok
item.description: Before vs. After Secret Wars is an AI TikTok trend where popular characters are shown before and after the "secret wars," referring to Marvel Comics' "Secret Wars" storyline, where heroes from across the multiverse are sent to a planet called Battleworld to fight against villains. The trend was started by TikToker @warpintime5 in late January 2026 and became increasingly popular through early February, inspiring accuracy reenactments and other memes referencing the format.

item.title: YouTuber 'Ben Palmer' Sets Up Fake ICE Tip Line, Catches Kindergarten Teacher Reporting Her Student's Parents
item.description: Kindergarten Teacher Calls ICE On Student refers to backlash over a viral video by YouTuber Ben Palmer where he shares a recording of a kindergarten teacher calling into his fake ICE tip line to report one of her students and their parents, who she suspects might be undocumented. The video was uploaded on February 2nd, 2026 and went viral over the following days, inspiring reactions from some people on social media, including attempts to find the teacher and get her fired.
